summary: The bill requires the FDA to publish educational materials and annual data on human cell and tissue product registrations, inspections, and Tissue Reference Group inquiries, hold stakeholder workshops, open a public docket for comments on regulation, and report recommendations to Congress by September 2026 on modernizing oversight including minimal manipulation and homologous use criteria.
